title: int:EVChargingStation
description: Electric vehicle charging station. Subclass of int:Asset. OCPP-compliant.

maxChargePower.description: Maximum charge power in watts. IRI: cim:maxChargePower. Unit: W.

maxDischargePower.description: Maximum discharge power in watts (V2G). IRI: cim:maxDischargePower. Unit: W.

powerFlowCapability.description: G2V only or V2G capable. IRI: int:powerFlowCapability.

chargingMode.description: AC or DC charging mode. IRI: int:chargingMode.

numberOfConnectors.description: Number of physical connectors. IRI: int:numberOfConnectors. Whole number, min 1.
